TSAC champion | bowl = NCAA Division II National Championship Game | bowl_result = W 17–7 vs. {{cfb link|year=1990|team=Westminster Titans|title=Westminster (PA)}} }} {{1990 Tri-State Athletic Conference football standings}} The '''1990 Peru State Bobcats football team''' was an [[American football]] team that represented [[Peru State College]] and won the national championship during the [[1990 NAIA Division II football season]]. In their fifth season under head coach [[Tom Shea]], the Bobcats compiled a 12–0–1 record. They participated in the NAIA Division II playoffs, defeating {{cfb link|year=1990|team=Dickinson State Blue Hawks|title=Dickinson State}} (38–34) in the quarterfinals, {{cfb link|year=1990|team=Baker Wildcats|title=Baker}} (27–3) in the semifinals and {{cfb link|year=1990|team=Westminster Titans|title=Westminster (PA)}} (17–7) in the NAIA Division II Championship Game.{{cite news|title=Long trips
